content:
The image shows coffee berries on a branch. Key observations:
- Mixed ripeness stages (green, yellow-green, orange, red, and dark/black berries)
- Several berries display large dark brown to blackish discoloration covering significant portions of the berry surface
- Some berries appear to have undergone premature ripening (the dark/black berries among unripe green ones)
- The dark patches are irregular and in some cases nearly cover the whole berry

**Matching against classes:**

- **Berry_Blotch**: "brown irregular spots on berries, sometimes covering the whole berry; young fruit tend to ripen prematurely" — matches the large dark patches and premature ripening pattern
- **Brown_Eye_Spot**: "smaller irregular brown spots mainly on sun-exposed side" — spots described as smaller, doesn't match the large coverage seen here
- Other classes (Rust, Miner, Phoma, Cerscospora) are primarily leaf diseases or affect different plant parts

The large dark areas covering significant portions of berries and the premature ripening pattern strongly align with Berry_Blotch over Brown_Eye_Spot.
